plan.hypothesis: At the frozen robot, task, evaluator, timing and controller implementation (controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0), a nonzero terminal tip-speed weight (control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight > 0), alone or jointly with a small holding tip-speed weight retained near 0.05, may lower the sampled final-window holding tip speed toward the frozen 0.02 m/s criterion while still retaining terminal reach acceptance (terminal_error_m <= 0.01 m). Scope: this is a tested-point claim about the two declared weight coordinates only; the supplied complete 0.30/0.0 result weakens reach-preserving improvement at that single tested point, not across the entire parameter range, and no dominant settling cause is claimed.
plan.rationale:
Stage 3.58 improvement search plan authored under a NEW separate grant and explicitly linked to the stopped Stage 3.57 predecessor plan (artifact 2ef6ee45913c43c9888aa77fbeec53a5b556abc49ce2b4ee1a7df7a50d72ded9), whose batch stopped with material_scheduler_failure_retained_baseline_reexecution. It reuses the accepted single-context diagnosis, the factual audit, the performed plans-view check, and the supplied complete 0.30/0 result.

Hypothesis scope. The plan tests only the two declared weight coordinates (control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight, control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight), each on the granted [0.0, 1.0] domain that contains the saved values 0.0, 0.05 and 0.30, with a coordinate step of 0.05 that stays clear of the forbidden open interval (0, 0.0001). Both paths are required to vary (nonzero-width domains). Everything else - robot, task, acceptance definition, evaluator, timing, the fixed controller controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 and all other numerical settings - is frozen. This is a tested-point search, not a range claim.

Prior evidence incorporated. The 0.05/0.0 configuration (improvement-96f0ade35119) is a sealed physical_tradeoff (F2420): sampled holding error improved by -0.001633544566242727 m (F2610) and sampled holding speed by -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F2329) while terminal error worsened by +0.001056295661744434 m (F2409); joint reach+holding acceptance stayed false (F2195, F2544) with terminal reach passing (F2476) and holding position/speed failing (F2410, F2578). The supplied complete 0.30/0.0 configuration (batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-1) shows lower sampled speed with worse positions and a lost terminal reach; per the audit this weakens reach-preserving improvement at that tested point only, not across the entire range. All THREE permitted complete historical configurations (0.0/0.0 baseline-replay, 0.05/0.0 improvement-96f0ade35119, 0.30/0.0 batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-1) are verified reusable and serve only as fixed frozen comparisons; they will not be re-run expecting new evidence. The genuinely untested coordinate is terminal_tip_speed_weight > 0, which the plan explores alone and jointly near the retained 0.05 holding value. Candidate-profile anchors: F2630, F2619, F2649, F2622, F2405.

Causal and range qualification. The audit's controller-side plan records are observations, not causes: raw optimizer termination is distinct from the controller policy stop; legal near-bound tensions coexist with zero bound violation (F2532, F2296); no dominant settling cause is claimed for any candidate, and no claim is made that any weight is ineffective throughout a parameter range. The untested search extent is bounded to the tested points only.

Acceptance separation. Frozen acceptance applies first: a candidate is promotable only if joint_reach_holding_acceptance is true; otherwise componentwise physical comparison applies and any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not an overall improvement; raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked (F2400, F2456, F2262, F2543, F2225, F2389). Diagnostic recommendation acceptance remains separate from controller-candidate selection and is not decided by this plan.

Execution hygiene. The installed method search.family_coordinate@1.0.0 supplies candidate ask/tell only; each proposed point still requires validated candidate.apply, simulation.run, evaluation.run and control.profile_report with bound_comparison and diagnostic_revision - a future evaluation and frozen comparison are required. Proposals include the start point and any duplicates. No separate numerical screening and no new baseline execution are authorized, and no backend run occurs in this authoring phase. max_candidates is capped at 4; max_backend_attempts=3 with one attempt reserved for a scheduler-failure re-attempt; target_changed_configurations=2 with normal stop after two distinct changed configurations complete simulation/evaluation/profile. The planned budget (backend_solves 3, tool_calls 18, model_calls 6, worker_calls 0, wall_s 6000) stays within the grant and preserves a 600 s wall and four provider/tool-slot reserve for interpretation and delivery. Scientific promise is uncertain: the holding-only lever moved sampled speed in the expected direction but only by a fraction of the gap, and the 0.30/0.0 point lost reach, while the terminal coordinate is genuinely untested.
stopping_conditions: Stop normally after exactly TWO distinct changed configurations have complete simulation, evaluation and profile, even if joint reach+holding acceptance occurs earlier.

Do not repeat the three known complete configurations (0.0/0.0 baseline-replay, 0.05/0.0 improvement-96f0ade35119, 0.30/0.0 batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-1) expecting new evidence; reuse them only as fixed, frozen comparisons.
Stop on any material failure per failure_policy=stop_on_material_failure; no more than max_backend_attempts=3 new full backend attempts, with one attempt reserved for a scheduler-failure re-attempt.
Reserve 600 s wall time and four provider/tool slots for interpretation and delivery; do not spend into that reserve.
Stop early if no further legal new point exists inside the declared domains without duplicating a known complete configuration or stepping into the forbidden open interval (0, 0.0001).
weakening_observations: The supplied complete 0.30/0.0 configuration (batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-1) lowers the sampled holding tip speed relative to the baseline while worsening holding position and losing terminal reach; read at its evidential scope this weakens reach-preserving improvement at that tested point only, not across the whole range.

The 0.05/0.0 configuration (improvement-96f0ade35119) is a sealed physical_tradeoff (F2420): sampled holding error improved by -0.001633544566242727 m (F2610) and sampled holding speed by -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F2329) while terminal error worsened by +0.001056295661744434 m (F2409), and joint reach+holding acceptance stayed false (F2195, F2544); each run shows physical improvement alongside physical worsening.

The holding tip-speed penalty moves the sampled hold speed only modestly and nowhere near the 0.02 m/s limit (candidate sampled speed 1.1750052670100422 m/s, F2271/F2619; candidate sampled error 0.05650455971948983 m, F2556/F2649), so a weight-only lever on this baseline may be low-yield while the untested coordinate remains terminal_tip_speed_weight > 0.

Zero force-bound violation in both runs (F2532 baseline, F2296 candidate) coexists with legal near-bound applied tensions approaching the 8.0 N per-tendon limit; legal near-bound loading is not a violation and does not establish a dominant force mechanism (audit-supported, not a causal finding).

Do not infer causality from citation validity: controller-side plan records reported by the performed check (optimization_selected_iteration 0 at update 16, F164; budget_best_feasible policy stop at update 16, F163; plan accepted at update 34, F175) are plan values, not backend motion, and raw optimizer termination is distinct from the controller policy stop.
